A few clarifying questions so we scope evidence correctly: 
- For HIPAA/PHI: can you confirm whether Nautar will sign a BAA for the pilot? If Nautar prefers not to sign a BAA at this stage, we need to know which customers and use cases will be excluded.
- Data residency: you mentioned regional retention windows — can you indicate whether any transcript storage will be in EU regions for EU customers (yes/no) and whether keys are customer-managed (SSE-KMS) or Nautar-managed?
- Evidence handoff: Jordan, would a shared Drive folder be easiest? If so, please share a folder link and an index (file list). We typically ask for:
  - network diagrams / dataflow (PDF/Dia)
  - authentication architecture (SAML/OIDC config snippets)
  - encryption at rest/in transit details (KMS ownership)
  - patching/vuln management evidence (scan reports)
  - SOC 2 artefacts (summary, in-scope systems)

If you want us to prefill the CAIQ, Marcus can start the mapping if you upload the Drive folder or return the attached spreadsheet filled. We can then send the filled CAIQ back for Jordan's review.

If SOC 2 Type II arrives before our next checkpoint, Grace will coordinate a crosswalk to speed acceptance. Can we tentatively schedule a 30-min technical handoff for Fri, Jul 23 2026 14:00 UTC? If that doesn't work, propose two alternate times.

Thanks — Neha
